caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow pie plate with a reddish-brown color and a rough, earthenware texture. The rim of the plate has a dotted pattern around its edge. The surface of the plate features five horizontal, wavy lines in a yellowish-green color, each line exhibiting irregular, flowing shapes and occasional swirls or loops. The plate is positioned upright, standing on a light brown rectangular wooden surface with a visible wood grain pattern. The background is a plain, off-white color, and the words "PIE PLATE" are printed above the plate in small, uppercase letters.
title: Pie Plate
